column1: # /Graph F10 view — XY scatter renders dots at (X[i], A[i]) coords
# Before this slice the F10 unicode path showed
# "XY graphs render in a later slice; press Esc to return."
# placeholder for /GTX. After: each (X[i], A[i]) pair becomes one
# `•` placed at the proportional position of x in [x_min..x_max]
# and y in [y_min..y_max]. Distinct from Line in that x positions
# come from the X range, not from a uniform sample-index grid.
# Reference p. 2-156, 2-159 ("XY: A graphs A series against X").
# /GA over B1..B4 — dependent series. Re-home + RIGHT so the POINT
# anchor lands at B1, not at the prior /GX endpoint.
# F10 — graph view. Placeholder gone, scatter dots present.
